quest.title: Summer Gift
quest.description: A mysterious, joyous gift lies somewhere, waiting to be discovered...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Looks like there's a letter next to it, too...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara's Letter
dialogues.text: To a friend who may have the fortune to come here,

dialogues.speaker: Barbara's Letter
dialogues.text: Hello there, person from afar. If you're reading this letter, then you must have found the harpastum I left here.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara's Letter
dialogues.text: The Golden Apple Archipelago is full of many games that involve harpasta, and I and my friends spent a most wonderful summer here.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara's Letter
dialogues.text: As such, I've left a harpastum that I made myself here, in the hopes that you, who have found that harpastum, can experience the same joys as I.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara's Letter
dialogues.text: Please enjoy the sunshine, the sea breeze, and the summer games to fullest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's Barbara for you! Guess we've got ourselves a harpastum now, so come on, let's go play!

talks.objective: Search for harpasta in the Golden Apple Archipelago
